name: Sau chit
summary: A worm from the stem of the chít plant. Vietnamnet says a stem with the worm does not flower, and that the worm is milk-white and plump, held in weak wine, then steeped as wine or cooked as porridge. Vietnam News names bamboo worms and does not say they are this worm. A strength and a price are Check on arrival.
origin: Dien Bien Phu. Vietnamnet, 8 Oct 2015, following Gia đình & Xã hội, is the account. It prints no street and no price.
howToEat: Split the chít stem, take the worm, and put it in a basin of weak wine so it does not change. Vietnamnet then says it is steeped as wine or cooked as porridge.
Vietnamnet calls the nutrition high and prints no measure. A strength and a price are Check on arrival.
where: No street was printed. Vietnam News’s bamboo worms are a separate name and were not identified as this worm. A stall hour is Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Sau chit in Dien Bien Phu — wine or porridge
seoDescription: The chít-stem worm, held in weak wine, then steeped as wine or cooked as porridge. Not identified as Vietnam News’s bamboo worms. A price is Check on arrival.
